decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording [URL_011] as the registered domain and GoDaddy as registrar; the warm-up assignment requires no additional registration-state change.
Purchasing and assigning [URL_011] for warm-up does not change the mailbox requirement's Gmail compatibility constraint or establish that this domain must be used for the mailbox.
The source identifies a domain for warm-up but does not resume or alter the deferred automated email campaign, its platform, channel, or automation mode.
The campaign warm-up domain purchase does not change the independently defined LinkedIn campaign configuration.
The source does not change or resume the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization or its Zap-based integration method.
The purchased warm-up domain does not alter the MeetAlfred configuration obligation or its Pro subscription plan.
The domain purchase neither changes nor resumes the deferred Zapier configuration requirement.
Selecting a warm-up domain does not affect the prohibition on using production MeetAlfred leads or the preferred non-production test identity.
The warm-up domain purchase does not change the requirement to preserve the existing MeetAlfred integration and campaigns.
The source does not alter or resume the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow or its campaign-cleanup rule.
The selected warm-up domain has no necessary effect on whether email and LinkedIn communication histories are visible in HubSpot.
The campaign domain purchase does not change Apollo contact enrichment, its provider, enriched fields, or automatic mode.
